title: Calamity Strikes
subtitle: A Quiet Morning Unmasks Hidden Dangers
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi laments a lack of excitement in the daily news, a few odd advertisements catch his sharp eye—hinting at secrets lurking beneath the mundane. As curiosity turns to suspicion, readers are drawn into a web where the ordinary may conceal treacherous intentions. Dive into this clever mystery and discover what calamity truly awaits.
